// diagnostic

E1107

The per-container layout prefix `columnar [T]` was written in a type.

What

The per-container layout prefix `columnar [T]` was written in a type.

Why

A per-use columnar override isn't built yet — only the whole-struct form `#Layout(columnar) struct …` ships in v1 (D-SOA2C reserves this spelling).

Fix

Put `#Layout(columnar)` on the `struct` declaration instead.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1107: tests/ui/layout_columnar_prefix_reserved.stderr.

Error [E1107]: the `columnar [T]` per-container layout form is reserved
  --> tests/ui/layout_columnar_prefix_reserved.jet:5:17
    |
  5 | fn use_them(ps: columnar [Particle]) Float -> ps[0].x
    |                 ^^^^^^^^
 Why: a per-use columnar override isn't built yet — only the whole-struct form ships
 Fix: put `#Layout(columnar)` on the `struct` declaration instead
